findings.rule: Owner rule (scout 268 constraints): migration is reversible, NO_RESPONSE stays recoverable, notes are kept (R14); no silent loss of user data
findings.trigger: Upgrade a v2 install with application 'silent' (status NO_RESPONSE, notes 'no reply yet'); after migration legacyStatus='NO_RESPONSE', notes kept. Accept one bullet: UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase.kt:18 -> upsertApplication -> JobApplication.asEntity() (ApplicationMappers.kt:11, no notes/legacyStatus) -> @Upsert rewrites every column, so notes becomes '' and legacyStatus NULL. The same happens in HandEditBulletUseCase and in DeleteAccountUseCase.restore (line 167), which then reports Failed(dataIntact = true) after a mid-loop deleteApplicationRow failure although the legacy columns were erased.
findings.title: Any full upsert of a migrated application silently erases legacy notes and legacyStatus, undoing the reversibility the migration preserves
findings.proof: OfflineFirstApplicationRepositoryTest: insert JobApplicationEntity(notes='n', legacyStatus='NO_RESPONSE') via the DAO, call upsertApplication(observed model), assert the row still has notes='n' and legacyStatus='NO_RESPONSE' (fails today). Fix: @Transaction upsert in OfflineFirstApplicationRepository that reads the existing row and carries notes and legacyStatus into the new entity.

findings.rule: Lead mandate (2) / Constitution I.5 data rights: delete account wipes every new table and MockStateStore key
findings.trigger: Insert a credit_ledger row (PURCHASE +5, applicationId 'app-1') and set resume settings LETTER/productUpdates=true; run DeleteAccountUseCase successfully (demo: deletesRemoteData=false; prod happy path with server delete OK). It clears profile, export history, application rows, credits via AccountCreditBalance and session keys (StoredSessionRepository.clear removes only ACCOUNT/LAST_ACCOUNT/ONBOARDING/KEPT_JOB/legacy keys), but never touches credit_ledger or resume.settings; RoomLocalDataWiper.wipeAll (the only clearAllTables/store.clear path) runs only on account switch and pending-wipe finish. The ledger with application ids and the settings survive account deletion and appear in the next download-my-data archive. LocalDataWiperSimplifiedFlowTest covers only RoomLocalDataWiper, so the PR's 'Constitution I.5 delete' evidence does not cover this path. DeleteMyDataUseCase likewise leaves ledger rows referencing deleted application ids.
findings.title: Account deletion leaves the new credit ledger and resume settings on the device
findings.proof: DeleteAccountUseCaseTest with TestCreditsRepository and TestResumeSettingsRepository seeded: after invoke() returns Deleted, assert observeLedger().first() is empty and observeSettings().first() == ResumeSettings() (fails today; DeleteAccountUseCase has no dependency on either repository).

findings.rule: Lead mandate (2): download-my-data exports every stored column, including legacyStatus and notes while they are still stored
findings.trigger: Migrated v2 row with notes 'Referral from a Saffron Retail colleague' and legacyStatus 'NO_RESPONSE': the notes text and legacyStatus stay in job_applications, but the model drops them (JobApplication has no notes) so applicationJson/applicationsText write neither; the user can neither see nor export personal free text the app still holds.
findings.title: Archive omits legacy notes and legacyStatus that remain stored on the device
findings.proof: AccountDataArchiveWriter test fed from a migrated row: assert the my-data JSON holds notes and legacyStatus for that application (fails today). Note: scout constraint says notes leave the archive (R14); the lead must reconcile that with mandate (2), for example by exporting them as legacy fields or clearing them once with consent.

findings.rule: 268-c9 with ProfileLimits: the backend payload holds up to MAX_ENTRIES confirmed sendable facts
findings.trigger: Profile with 40 confirmed IMPORTED entries plus 3 confirmed USER_ANSWER entries placed before some of them: confirmedWithinLimits() takes the first 40 entries and the bullet budget of 200 before toFactsDto drops USER_ANSWER, so only 37 IMPORTED entries (and fewer bullets) reach the backend although 40 fit.
findings.title: USER_ANSWER entries consume the entry and bullet limits before they are filtered out
findings.proof: MappersTest: 3 USER_ANSWER then 40 IMPORTED confirmed entries -> assert toFactsDto().entries.size == 40 (gets 37). Fix: filter USER_ANSWER before applying confirmedWithinLimits.
